allow: PowerShell($r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.warframestat.us/solNodes?language=en" -Headers @{Accept="application/json"}; \($r.PSObject.Properties | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { @{ key = $_.Name; val = $_.Value } }\) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4)

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.warframestat.us/pc/missions?language=en" -Headers @{Accept="application/json"} -TimeoutSec 10; $r | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Select-Object -First 30 } catch { Write-Output "missions endpoint: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
